subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these fourteen upstream action revisions after a trusted final-head workflow run confirms that the credentialed token, Codex, release/Docker, and security-scan paths retain their intended privilege boundaries?
rationale: The protected security label and upgrades to third-party executable actions in credential-bearing workflows require owner acceptance of the exact runtime behavior; source inspection cannot substitute for that operational decision.

options.title: Refresh and validate before merge
options.body: Rebase or recreate the Dependabot update on current `main`, inspect a trusted final-head run for the sensitive workflows, then merge if their existing contracts remain intact.

options.title: Defer the grouped update
options.body: Close or pause this batch if the owners prefer reviewing these action upgrades in smaller trust-boundary groups.

recommendation.title: Refresh and validate before merge
recommendation.body: Rebase or recreate the Dependabot update on current `main`, inspect a trusted final-head run for the sensitive workflows, then merge if their existing contracts remain intact.
